title: Rate and depth of two-axis twisting by pair exchange under the self-Kerr constraint
summary: In this paper, we study two bosonic modes that exchange pairs of quanta, which realize two-axis twisting exactly: within a sector of fixed particle number the exchange operator is proportional to the two-axis twisting generator, with a fixed factor of two. Because any real nonlinear medium supplies a local Kerr nonlinearity alongside this operator, the two merge into one twisting Hamiltonian governed by a single dimensionless ratio $r=χ_s/χ_e$ of the Kerr strength to the exchange strength.
